start.content: I am Simon Peter. Three times I denied the man I swore I would never deny. The rooster crowed, and He turned. I saw the look in His eyes — disappointment, not anger. I am a broken man.

choices.text: The look — what did it mean?

denials.content: First, by the fire. 'Woman, I do not know him.' Then again — 'I do not know the man.' The third time, I cursed and swore I was not one of His disciples. Each denial carved deeper than the last.

look.content: He turned. Not with rage — never with rage. But His eyes... they held all the love I had broken. I saw my own weakness reflected there. I went out and wept. That night, I thought I was finished.

closing.content: I am here. I do not know why. Perhaps grace is too heavy for me to understand. The other disciples avoided me. My calling felt burned away with those words. Say what you will — but I was broken.
